rows.desktop_responsibility: Own shipping Fabushi browser login, encrypted durable session persistence, identity verification, access-token refresh, logout/revocation, bounded CI session admission, and private Host access credential projection without exposing refresh credentials.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: Users sign in through Fabushi, long-lived sessions refresh with stable identity, logout/account changes revoke stale model credentials, and model inference receives only the current account access credential.
rows.ios_platform_delta: The native iOS product client owns browser/account session lifecycle and encrypted secrets; Host model inference resolves the current Rust-owned session token at request time instead of consuming an Electron credential file.
rows.notes: Current inference credential resolver rereads the Product session for each inference so logout/account switching cannot retain a stale bearer. Desktop c64035cca2bdb301e948036250ed6ffcc6ea7e42 also re-exports the canonical deployed Responses URL policy; iOS keeps endpoint ownership in Rust AppHost rather than Swift/UI.
